# Evidence fixtures

All files are committed binaries, each under 20 KB.

- `sample.pdf`: two pages, uncompressed, Helvetica text "Batch record BMR-2026-0142 page one" and "Deviation DEV-0031 raised on page two". Written by `make-fixtures.py` (computes the xref offsets).
- `scanned.pdf`: one page with an empty content stream (no text layer). Same script.
- `sample.docx`: zip built with Python's `zipfile` (`[Content_Types].xml`, `_rels/.rels`, `word/document.xml`) with paragraphs "Training matrix" and "Operator A signed off on 2026-03-02". Same script.
- `chars19.pdf`, `chars20.pdf`: one page with 19 and 20 non-whitespace characters (the no_text threshold). Same script.
- `sample.csv`: `batch,result\n0142,pass\n`. Same script.
- `sample.xlsx`: written once with exceljs 4: sheet `Log`, header `Batch | Result`, rows `0142 | pass` and `0143 | fail` (all strings). Not regenerated by the script (a re-run of exceljs gives different bytes only in timestamps).

Regenerate the first four with `python3 make-fixtures.py` from this directory.
